title: Family: Theresa Wilson, siblings and Two Row Street
summary: Daughter Theresa Wilson gives her name and siblings; he had one sister and was born on Union Street near Royal.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: He'd never holler at none of us. Never holler at none of us. He'd never call just and we'd come home. He never raised his voice. I'd come after Paul.
That van had a van. That van had a van, boy. Could we get your name on the table? We'd like to have it. What would be the call? We could have your full name too. Yes. Your married name.
Theresa Wilson.
Theresa Wilson. Yeah. How many brothers did you have with Paul all together? We have four of us. Four brothers. Four brothers and one sister? No.

It was four sisters. We were four sisters. It was five sisters that one died when she was small. We were eight. We were nine. Yeah, nine. But I mean eight we were living. Now we're six. We lost two recently about four years ago. Brother and a sister. Did his brothers and sisters play music? He didn't have any brothers. One sister. Your sister didn't play any kind of instrument, huh? Who? Your sister.
No, no.
He didn't have any brothers.
Any father? No, I asked him.
He said no.
What part of town were you all raised in when you were children?

On two row between Ramport and Burgundy. That's right over on the other side of Claiborne. That's right. That's most on the French part of town. That's right. Coming from the Vicare, about nine blocks from the Vicare. Where was he born? Was he born in the city? Yeah, he was born in the city. Where was he born? Do you remember where he was born? What street or where? Yeah, I was born on... Union Street. Union Street.
That's what he had. He used to call those streets, Donnie. Union and what? Union and what?
What was Union Street after Union Street? What they call it, street? That wasn't St. Claude, huh?
No, Union Street was on this one.
Yeah, but what street that was? What street that they named it now, Union Street?
Two Roles.
Two Roles?
Mm-hmm. And what was across street?
Between what two streets? In between what two streets? St. Claude, Marie-Oycourt, or where?
Uh-uh. He didn't change all of the streets.
I know, but just tell me Nasser, he'll know.
Where was...
Hmm?
Ask him if it was near Claiborne or around the park.
I should have asked him now. Was it near Claiborne? I don't think it was that far. I don't know. It was around St. Claude?
No, around the Royal and the... Oh, around Royal.

That's in the big... Those men was changed. Yeah. You know what he mean, around Royal. Was Callerette Street far? Yeah. Around Callerette, you know, Peat Street? You know that little street they call Peat Street? Yeah, they all there. They must have been up around there, huh?
Around there. They're all there. Oh. Carol Wrig Street's supposed to be after Espranade. That's right. But, uh... Yeah, after Espranade. Mm-hmm.

Then they had a little cut street. Then you come to Two Row. And Dauphine Street cut across and Two Row would run... Right continuation. Right here. I say, you come down Boybin Street... When you come down Two Row Street would run from... Oh, where was it in that cut there? By Dauphine up in there. And run back.
Yeah, that was... Two Row Street. Used to run back for as a... A good way back. Yeah, I know.
